verdict.oneLineSummary: Fine-grained permissions and webhooks, but watch out for the required Webhook URL trap.

capabilityCheck.question: Can an agent receive real-time webhook events and act on organizational repositories?
capabilityCheck.detail: GitHub Apps are designed for organization-level bot automation with granular, per-resource permissions (e.g. read issues, write pull requests without granting full repo access). Webhooks are first-class.

steps.text: Navigate to Settings → Developer settings → GitHub Apps → New GitHub App.

fields.name: GitHub App name
fields.note: Must be globally unique across all of GitHub.

fields.name: Callback URL
fields.note: Required if you request user authorization tokens

steps.text: DISABLE Webhooks if you only need API access (The #1 beginner blocker).

fields.name: Webhook → 'Active' checkbox
fields.note: UNCHECK THIS. By default, GitHub checks 'Active' and will throw a validation error if you don't provide a public Webhook URL.

fields.name: Webhook URL / Webhook secret
fields.note: Leave empty once Active is unchecked.

steps.text: Select granular Repository and Organization permissions.

fields.name: Permissions (Repository / Organization / Account)
fields.note: Defaults to 'No access' on all resources. Explicitly select only what your agent needs (e.g. Pull requests: Read & write).

steps.text: Choose installation availability under 'Where can this GitHub App be installed?'.

fields.name: Where can this be installed?
fields.valueOrAdvice: Only on this account (during dev), Any account (for public users)

blockers.issue: The Webhook 'Active' checkbox is enabled by default, blocking submission with 'Webhook URL cannot be blank' even when you don't need webhooks.
blockers.workaround: Uncheck the 'Active' checkbox under Webhook settings before clicking Create.

composio.recommendation: Composio provides managed tooling that eliminates manual private key creation and JWT generation required by raw GitHub Apps.

evidence.claim: Directly tested GitHub App registration: confirmed global name uniqueness requirement and observed webhook active toggle blocking the submit button.
evidence.label: TESTED
